title: Argentina, Egypt Advance in Dramatic Finishes as World Cup Round of 32 Concludes
detail: The Round of 32 wrapped up July 1-3: France beat Sweden 3-0 (Mbappe 45', 74'), Norway beat Cote d'Ivoire 2-1 on Erling Haaland's 86th-minute winner, Mexico beat Ecuador 2-0 at Estadio Azteca, England beat DR Congo 2-1, Belgium beat Senegal 3-2 after extra time on a contested late penalty, USA beat Bosnia & Herzegovina 2-0, Spain beat Austria 3-0, Portugal beat Croatia 2-1, Switzerland beat Algeria 2-0, Egypt beat Australia 4-2 on penalties after a 1-1 draw, Colombia beat Ghana 1-0, and Argentina beat Cabo Verde 3-2 after extra time, with Lionel Messi scoring his 7th career World Cup goal. All 16 Round of 16 matchups are now set.

media.caption: Round of 32 concludes with Argentina and Egypt both advancing in extra time and on penalties
